# Story Log: Hearth & Hall (template)

> **Becomes a Claude Doc in the first play session. Each session gets its own new tab** (or its own section, if tabs aren't available), named `Session NN · short title`.
>
> ## Format rules (follow these every time)
> 1. **One tab per session.** Never rewrite an earlier session's tab.
> 2. **Scene by scene, in order.** Each scene gets a short heading (place, time of day) and a few paragraphs of book-style narration in past tense.
> 3. **Key dialogue** goes in, word for word where it matters, especially anything Ash said, promised or was promised.
> 4. **Ash's choices and why:** for each real decision, a line in the form `Choice: … · Why (as Ash saw it): …`. Use Jeremy's stated reasons if he gave them. Otherwise write "reason not stated."
> 5. **Only what Ash knew.** No sealed content, no DM-only reasons, no "little did he know." If Ash didn't see it, it isn't in the log.
> 6. Rolls are mentioned only when they shaped the story (a crit, a failed save that mattered).
> 7. **End every tab with "Threads left open":** a bullet list of questions, promises, debts and leads, as Ash would describe them.
